title: He was still working on mathematics at his desk the day he died.

sources.text: Purdue University Department of Mathematics - Tribute to Shreeram S. Abhyankar
MacTutor History of Mathematics Archive, University of St Andrews - Abhyankar biography

caption:
He was still working on mathematics at his desk the day he died.

He earned his PhD at Harvard under Oscar Zariski, then spent his career at Purdue, becoming the Marshall Distinguished Professor of Mathematics in 1967.

He supervised 28 PhD students and received multiple honorary doctorates internationally, putting an Indian-born mathematician at the center of 20th-century algebraic geometry.

Abhyankar's theorems are still cited in mathematics departments worldwide - a quieter but lasting form of Indian intellectual export.
